sonnet.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to guess a word in the middle of a line ("You are My ___"). Nothing in the earlier cards sets up Son versus Servant or Shepherd. The only way to pick is by recalling or guessing the wording, so a thoughtful baker can't reason it out.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. ... The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
